---
title: Table labels and inline terms
filters:
  - html-tex
  - pdf-helper
terms:
  ara:
    pdf: '\ara{}'
    html: '<span class="ara">Ara</span>'
format:
  html: default
  pdf:
    pdf-engine: pdflatex
    classoption: twocolumn
    keep-tex: true
    latex-clean: false
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage{booktabs}
        \newcommand{\ara}{\textsc{Ara}}
    html-tex:
      md-table-env: table*
      html-table-env: table
      table-caption-pos: bottom
---

Before **bold ({{< term ara >}})** after.
